reference_role: Attainable profiled conditional CAR fit; not independently measured proportions
metric_definition: Negative complete CAR/inverse-gamma log posterior after exact nuisance profiling, divided by genes*spots; maximum over the seven declared phi values. Positive excess means worse fit.
tolerance_provenance: Predeclared dimensionless 1e-6 per gene-spot logposterior budget; not measured sequencing noise. Both all-type outputs are checked.
